layout.strategy: mobile-first, centered app-like container (max-w-md or max-w-lg) for the main planner, with heavy padding. Bento-style grid for desktop statistics. Thick borders and rounded elements to mimic Duolingo gamification.

typography.instructions: Use Tajawal exclusively for a cohesive, rounded, and friendly Arabic interface. Headings must be heavy (font-bold or font-black). Line-height should be leading-relaxed for Arabic body text to ensure readability with diacritics.

surface_strategy.cards: Neumorphic tactile variant. Flat white background, border-2 border-gray-200, rounded-2xl, heavy border-b-4. On hover/active: translate-y-[2px], border-b-2 (push-down effect).
surface_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or ultra-rounded (rounded-2xl). Must have border-b-4 of a darker shade of the background color to look 3D and clickable.
surface_strategy.inputs: rounded-xl border-2 border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 focus:border-primary focus:bg-white focus:ring-0 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-[#1CB05B] text-white border-b-4 border-[#148643] hover:bg-[#179B4F] active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-[4px] rounded-2xl px-6 py-3 font-bold text-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-700 border-2 border-gray-200 border-b-4 hover:bg-gray-50 active:border-b-2 active:translate-y-[2px] rounded-2xl px-6 py-3 font-bold text-lg

timeline.container: relative border-r-4 border-gray-200 ml-4 pl-6 (Note: RTL so border-r becomes border-l mathematically, use border-s-4 or logical properties)
timeline.prayer_node: absolute -start-3 bg-white border-4 rounded-full w-6 h-6 z-10
timeline.task_card: mb-4 bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 border-b-4 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:border-primary

badges.streak: flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[#FF9600] bg-orange-50 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border-2 border-[#FF9600]

icons_and_assets.instructions: Use rounded, friendly icons. Adjust strokeWidth to 2.5 for a bolder, gamified look.

hero_mascot.description: Minimalist white mosque with green domes, cute playful style, no faces. Use for empty states or welcome screen.

achievement_lantern.description: Traditional Ramadan lantern fanous, warm yellow light. Use for badges or high-streak rewards.

streak_crescent.description: Glowing crescent moon and gold stars. Use as a streak icon or for Isha prayer visualization.

background_pattern.description: Intricate green and gold islamic geometric pattern. Use as a subtle low-opacity background for header or achievement modals.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure white text on #1CB05B has sufficient contrast. Use #148643 for borders.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-task-button', data-testid='prayer-fajr-node').

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Set <html dir='rtl' lang='ar'> in index.html.
Include Google Font 'Tajawal' in index.html or import it in CSS.
Use Tailwind logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-, border-s) to natively support the RTL layout without breaking when changing sides.
For gamified cards, always use bottom-heavy borders (border-b-4) to simulate 3D buttons. When active/pressed, remove the border-b or translate down to simulate pressing.
Group daily tasks visually strictly between the 5 daily prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha). The layout should visually connect these anchors.
Implement local storage to save streaks and points.
Ensure NO faces are rendered if any external assets are fetched, abiding by the strict religious requirement.
Utilize the provided assets for empty states, achievement popups, and UI decoration.
